about: Places the user reported in review (screenshots), with what must or must not be in the output there. Re-check every new build with scripts/check_reported_cases.py on fresh outputs of these files. Coordinates: EPSG:3763 metres.

kinds.line_at: a Highway line passes within r of the point
kinds.no_line_at: no Highway line passes within r of the point
kinds.no_polygon_at: no Other Marks polygon lies within r of the point
kinds.polygon_at: an Other Marks polygon lies within r of the point
kinds.client_iou_at: our polygon at the point overlaps the client's mark there with IoU >= min
